prerequisites: No specific prerequisites. Basic knowledge in algorithms and data structures is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the most important bioinformatic methods required for calculations in the scientific field.
They are able to select and apply suitable bioinformatic methods for specific case studies.

syllabus_topics: Selected bioinformatic methods required for calculations in the scientific field
Algorithms for sequence alignments (e.g., Needleman-Wunsch, Smith-Waterman, ClustalW, BLAST)
Methods from structural bioinformatics (e.g., Pymol, Docking)

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual exam) or written exam

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, along with an oral presentation of the solution for at least two of the exercise assignments. The final grade is determined by an oral examination (individual exam) or a written exam. Grading is on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
bibliography: Selzer, Marhöfer, Rohwer: Applied Bioinformatics, Springer
Further literature will be announced during the course.
